solidworks_sketch_add_tangent_arc.doc: Draw an arc tangent to the last sketch segment, through one point and ending at another. Creates sketch geometry in millimetres from the sketch origin; the open sketch must already hold the segment the arc stays tangent to, and arc_type is an integer whose value table no available source documents.

params.end_x_mm: X of the arc end in millimetres, from the sketch origin.
params.end_y_mm: Y of the arc end in millimetres.
params.through_x_mm: X of a point the arc passes through, in millimetres.
params.through_y_mm: Y of that point the arc passes through, in millimetres.
params.arc_type: Arc type as an integer passed through unchanged, because its value table could not be found in the available sources; defaults to 1.

solidworks_sketch_add_3point_arc.doc: Draw an arc through three points: its start, its end and one point on the arc. Creates sketch geometry in millimetres from the sketch origin; start the sketch first with solidworks_sketch_start, draw, then call solidworks_sketch_end.

params.start_x_mm: X of the arc start in millimetres, from the sketch origin.
params.start_y_mm: Y of the arc start in millimetres.
params.end_x_mm: X of the arc end in millimetres.
params.end_y_mm: Y of the arc end in millimetres.
params.through_x_mm: X of a point on the arc, in millimetres.
params.through_y_mm: Y of that point on the arc, in millimetres.

solidworks_sketch_add_partial_ellipse.doc: Draw a partial ellipse from its centre, a point on each axis and the arc start and end. Creates sketch geometry in millimetres from the sketch origin; direction sets the sweep sense, so start the sketch first with solidworks_sketch_start and finish with solidworks_sketch_end.

params.center_x_mm: X of the ellipse centre in millimetres, from the sketch origin.
params.center_y_mm: Y of the ellipse centre in millimetres.
params.major_x_mm: X of a point on the major axis in millimetres.
params.major_y_mm: Y of that point on the major axis in millimetres.
params.minor_x_mm: X of a point on the minor axis in millimetres.
params.minor_y_mm: Y of that point on the minor axis in millimetres.
params.start_x_mm: X of the arc start in millimetres.
params.start_y_mm: Y of the arc start in millimetres.
params.end_x_mm: X of the arc end in millimetres.
params.end_y_mm: Y of the arc end in millimetres.
params.direction: Sweep direction: 1 = counter-clockwise, -1 = clockwise; defaults to 1.

solidworks_sketch_add_parabola.doc: Draw a parabola from its focus, its apex and two points that set its ends. Creates sketch geometry in millimetres from the sketch origin; start the sketch first with solidworks_sketch_start, draw, then call solidworks_sketch_end.

params.focus_x_mm: X of the focus in millimetres, from the sketch origin.
params.focus_y_mm: Y of the focus in millimetres.
params.apex_x_mm: X of the apex in millimetres.
params.apex_y_mm: Y of the apex in millimetres.
params.start_x_mm: X of the start point in millimetres.
params.start_y_mm: Y of the start point in millimetres.
params.end_x_mm: X of the end point in millimetres.
params.end_y_mm: Y of the end point in millimetres.

solidworks_sketch_add_conic.doc: Draw a conic curve from its focus, its apex and two points that set its ends. Creates sketch geometry in millimetres from the sketch origin; the argument layout is identical in shape to the parabola one, so start the sketch first and finish with solidworks_sketch_end.

params.focus_x_mm: X of the focus in millimetres, from the sketch origin.
params.focus_y_mm: Y of the focus in millimetres.
params.apex_x_mm: X of the apex in millimetres.
params.apex_y_mm: Y of the apex in millimetres.
params.start_x_mm: X of the start point in millimetres.
params.start_y_mm: Y of the start point in millimetres.
params.end_x_mm: X of the end point in millimetres.
params.end_y_mm: Y of the end point in millimetres.

solidworks_sketch_add_perimeter_circle.doc: Draw a circle that passes through three points in the open sketch. Creates sketch geometry in millimetres from the sketch origin; this call takes six numbers and no Z value, unlike its sibling primitives, so start the sketch first and finish with solidworks_sketch_end.

params.x1_mm: X of the first point in millimetres, from the sketch origin.
params.y1_mm: Y of the first point in millimetres.
params.x2_mm: X of the second point in millimetres.
params.y2_mm: Y of the second point in millimetres.
params.x3_mm: X of the third point in millimetres.
params.y3_mm: Y of the third point in millimetres.

solidworks_gui_get_foreground_window.doc: Get the window handle of whatever currently holds foreground focus. Read-only and model-free; call it before driving the GUI so the next keys or clicks land in the intended window instead of in whichever one had focus.

solidworks_gui_screen_png.doc: Write a full-screen PNG capture to path as evidence of what the SolidWorks window showed. Writes the image file and never touches SolidWorks itself, so it still works while a modal dialog blocks the COM session; it grabs the whole screen because a window-only capture loses the floating windows outside the client area.

params.path: Absolute path of the PNG file to write; the source has no usable default, so always pass a real path. Defaults to an empty string.

solidworks_revolve_cut.doc: Revolve a profile sketch into a cut feature around an axis, removing material from the part. Creates a cut feature and does not save the document; the axis has to enter the selection set before the profile, and an omitted axis name means the sketch centreline is used.

params.sketch_name: Name of the profile sketch exactly as it appears in the feature tree. Defaults to empty.
params.angle_deg: Revolve angle in degrees, converted once to the radians the official call takes. Defaults to 0.0.
params.axis_sketch_name: Name of the axis sketch to revolve about, selected before the profile; empty selects no axis and uses the centreline in the profile sketch. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_ref_geometry_create_3d_boundi.doc: Create a 3D bounding box for a cut list item of a weldment part. Creates a sketch that becomes the box and does not save the document; on an ordinary part, or on a part without a selected cut list item, nothing is created and the feature tree not growing is the expected result.

solidworks_sketch_select_segment.doc: Select one sketch segment by its position in the active sketch so later sketch commands act on it. Modifies the selection list and returns the read-back selection count rather than the call's own success flag; selecting the segment that is already selected deselects it.

params.index: Zero-based position of the segment in the active sketch; the order is not promised to stay stable across a rebuild. Defaults to 0.
params.append: True appends the segment to the existing selection, false replaces the selection with it; a running PropertyManager command ignores this and always appends. Defaults to false.

solidworks_surface_cut.doc: Create a surface-cut feature that cuts solids with a preselected surface or plane. Writes a feature into the active part and does not save the document; select the cutting surface or plane first, and keep_piece_index chooses which piece survives when the cut is ambiguous.

params.flip: True reverses the side the cut is taken from, false keeps it; defaults to false.
params.keep_piece_index: Which resulting piece to keep when the cut is ambiguous, as a zero-based result index; -1 means the result is unambiguous. Defaults to 0.
params.use_feat_scope: True cuts only the bodies in this feature's scope that the surface intersects, false cuts every intersecting body; defaults to false.
params.use_auto_select: True cuts every body the surface intersects, false cuts only the bodies given explicitly; defaults to true.

solidworks_weldment_iter_features.doc: Walk the weldment feature folders and list the cut list folders with their sub-features. Read-only; it recurses through sub-features instead of reporting only top-level nodes, so the result is the whole tree below the weldment folder.

solidworks_simulation_apply_convection.doc: Apply a convection load to the selected faces of a thermal simulation study. Creates one load in the study and does not save the document; the ok flag comes from the load count rising by exactly one rather than from the return value, and a static study leaves the count unchanged, so create a thermal study first.

params.study_name: Name of an existing simulation study; empty means the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.
params.selection: Declarative face selection the load applies to: '__current_selection__' for the current selection or 'index:<n>' for the n-th face on the body.

solidworks_simulation_apply_heat_flux.doc: Apply a heat flux load to the selected faces of a thermal simulation study. Creates one load in the study and does not save the document; the ok flag comes from the load count rising by exactly one rather than from the return value, and a static study leaves the count unchanged, so create a thermal study first.

params.study_name: Name of an existing simulation study; empty means the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.
params.selection: Declarative face selection the load applies to: '__current_selection__' for the current selection or 'index:<n>' for the n-th face on the body.

solidworks_simulation_apply_heat_power.doc: Apply a heat power load to the selected faces of a thermal simulation study. Creates one load in the study and does not save the document; the ok flag comes from the load count rising by exactly one rather than from the return value, and a static study leaves the count unchanged, so create a thermal study first.

params.study_name: Name of an existing simulation study; empty means the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.
params.selection: Declarative face selection the load applies to: '__current_selection__' for the current selection or 'index:<n>' for the n-th face on the body.
